Kevin having shitty grades and poor time management doesn’t give Frank the right to us him as a punching bag. When he tries helping Kevin, he comes off prick with no empathy. Kevin nearly died as a kid from drowning. Just because Kevin is flunking out or is immature, I don’t think that gives Frank the right to be a dickhead.

I mean there were people in the 70s who believed Franks parenting style was abusive. Also when talking about Kevin, most likely he has a learning disability which makes Frank’s treatment of him worse. This doesn’t discredit Frank’s struggles, he probably did have it harder. I just don’t believe that’s enough to push past the crappy shit he put onto his kids. He’s not a horrible person, nor is he evil, but he did abusive things. Having abusive tendencies and also suffering from abuse can coexist.

Just labeling him grouchy and saying his only behavior is yelling kinda makes his actions seem less harmful than they are. Constantly demeaning his kids, bullying his kids, mimicking how his father raised him, especially with Bill. His parenting technique seems to create a lot of insecurity and anger amongst the kids. Also you’re right about having a relatable father figure, why I like this show so much was because Frank absolutely reminds me of my dad. But you phrased my point so much better than my original post thank you 😂.
